units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 5:22">Targ. Y. ib. V, 22</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 5:24">24</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 6:18">Targ. II Chr. VI, 18</cite> (h. text <he>האמנם</he>); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 26:7">Lev. R. s. 26</cite> <he>אנא בעלם דק׳</he> … <he>מילין דק׳</he> I (Samuel) am now in the world of truth (v. <cite ref="P00823"><he>עָלְמָא</he></cite>), and thou shalt hear from me none but words of truth; Tanḥ. Emor 2.
<cite ref="Shabbat 104a:9">Sabb. 104ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ קאי</he> truth stands firm (v. <cite ref="L00096"><he>לְבַן</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 97a:6">Snh. 97ᵃ</cite> <he>מריש … ליכא ק׳ בעלמא וכ׳</he> formerly I thought there was no truth in the world.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 97a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>איקלע … ק׳ שמיה</he> he came to a place named Ḳushṭa (Truth); a. fr.—Pl. <he>קוּשְׁטִין</he>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 22:37">Targ. Y. Num. XXII, 37</cite> <he>מן ק׳</he> (h. text <he>האמנם</he>).—Y. Ḥag. II, beg. 77ᵃ <he>ק׳ אתון אמרין דהין וכ׳</he> do you (Jews) indeed say that the world is maintained by air?

senses.gloss: (sub. גבר) true. Targ. II Esth. I, 2 תמים וק׳ upright and true.
